name: Shanghai Gensoutan ~Teito Kitan Gaiden~
original_name: 上海幻想譚 ～帝都奇譚外伝～
source:
Several months after events of Teito Kitan ~Doushi Tantei no Jiken Memo~. 
Kudo  was staying at Iwasaki residence in Shanghai with Aya when they were assaulted and Aya kidnapped. Iwasaki tells Kudo that the attack was done by members of "The Legion Party", a secret society that appeared in Shanghai lately. Kudo takes maid Masha as assistant and starts investigation.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-june-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
故事發生在《帝都奇譚～道士偵探事件簿～》的數月之後。
工藤與綾一同住在上海的巖崎宅邸，卻突然遭到襲擊，綾也被人擄走。巖崎告訴工藤，發動襲擊的是「軍團黨」成員；這是一個不久前才在上海出現的秘密結社。工藤帶著女僕瑪莎當助手，開始調查此案。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-june-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
